builderIntro: Point it at any web API, fetch one real response, then click the value you want to show in chat.
errNameRequired: Enter a name for this data source.
errUrlRequired: Enter the web address to fetch.
builderNoSample: The API answered, but its response could not be read automatically. Paste one below instead.
builderPickPrompt: Click the value you want to show in chat.
description: Connect third-party APIs your commands can quote live. {count} of 20 definitions in use.
degraded: Live definition data is unreachable right now. Showing nothing rather than stale rows. Retry shortly.
quotaReached: You've reached the {max} data source limit for your channel. Delete one to make room.
noneYetSub: Point one at any https JSON API, then drop its token into a command response.
slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Used inside {urlfetch:name}.
authEmpty: No API keys yet. Add one in Settings, then pick it here.
authEmptyDelegate: Ask your channel owner to add an API key in Settings.
authHint: Keys are sealed before storage and never shown again. You see only the label and the last 4 characters.
templateHint: Try the token in a line like a command reply. Test run fills it with real data.
deleteRefs: These commands quote it. They lose this data if you delete:
deleteSafe: No commands reference this definition right now.
test_denied: The API refused the request. Check the URL, and pick the right key under API key if this API needs one.
test_limited: Rate limited. Wait a moment and test again.
test_upstream_error: The API returned an error. Chat sees nothing, unless the token has a |default: {urlfetch:name|default}.
test_timeout: The API timed out. Chat sees nothing, unless the token has a |default: {urlfetch:name|default}.
test_bad_def: This data source could not produce a value. Until it does, chat shows the token's |default value if it has one, otherwise {urlfetch:name} as typed. Check the web address and the API key, then click Fetch a sample again.
testNoAnswer: The fetch service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
keyNoneYet: No keys yet. Add one here before you add a data source for an API that needs a key.
keyNote: Values are encrypted before storage and never displayed or sent to chat again. Rotation replaces the value under the same label.
keyErrLabel: Give the key a label first.
keyErrExists: A key labeled "{label}" already exists. Use Rotate to replace it.
keyDeleteRefs: These data sources use this key and stop showing live data once it is deleted. To change the secret and keep them working, click Cancel and use Rotate.
keyDeleteSafe: No data sources use this key.
pickerTitle: Pick a value from a sample response
pickerHint: Paste one real response from your API, then click the value you want.
pickerTooBig: That sample is over {max} KB. Paste a shorter one.
pickerBadJson: That is not valid JSON. Fix it and the tree appears here.
pickerHuge: That sample expands to too many fields. Paste a smaller slice.
pickerEmpty: The tree appears once the JSON parses.
pickerTooDeep: Deeper than 8 levels. Pick something closer to the top.
pickerNeedsName: Give the definition a name first. Picked tokens need it.
pickerNoneYet: No definitions yet. Create one under Commands → Fetch definitions.
